ACCESS: surya.com sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge - a plain curl of https://www.surya.com/robots.txt returns the 'Just a moment...' interstitial (cRay a33a85d1bacc4bda, cType 'managed'), and probe.fetch's curl_cffi fingerprint rotation is equally blocked. The working route established by the prior Home-Decor and Furniture passes on this SR still works: r.jina.ai with the target URL PERCENT-ENCODED, called via plain curl with headers 'x-return-format: html' and 'x-no-cache: true'. That returns the genuine origin HTML (0.8-4.4 MB per page) including the Optimizely (Insite) B2B Commerce SSR JSON state blob. Every page cited below came back that way on this session; no 429 was hit.

ROBOTS: https://www.surya.com/robots.txt (read through the same route) is three lines - 'User-Agent: *' / 'Disallow:' (i.e. nothing disallowed) / 'sitemap: https://www.surya.com/sitemapindex.xml'. It names NO anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web or Claude-User agent and sets no Crawl-delay.

TREE - SOURCE 1 (sitemap): sitemapindex.xml -> a single child, https://www.surya.com/sitemap1.xml (4,438,285 bytes). It contains 29,614 distinct surya.com URLs, of which 4,957 are /Catalog/ paths. Stripping the 4,834 per-pattern /Brands/<Name>/Catalog/All entries leaves the complete browsable department tree: exactly 123 /Catalog/ URLs, and the catalogue is only TWO levels deep (/Catalog/<Dept>/<Node>) - no third level exists. The departments are Accents, Furniture, Lighting, Outdoor, Rugs, Textiles and Wall-Decor, plus the nav-only/promotional roots Clearance, New, Top-Sellers, Shop-All-Products, Collaborations (12 designer nodes), Promos (14 nodes) and ProductComparison.

TREE - SOURCE 2 (site's own nav): the rendered homepage (836,299 bytes) exposes exactly TEN top-level /Catalog/ hrefs and no others: Accents, Clearance, Furniture, Lighting, New, Outdoor, Rugs, Textiles, Top-Sellers, Wall-Decor. The two sources agree exactly. There is NO Bath, Bathroom, Bath & Body, Shower, Sanitaryware, Vanity, Faucet/Tap, Toilet, Basin/Sink, Bathroom-Storage or Bathroom-Accessories department, and no such node under any department.

EXHAUSTIVE NEGATIVE CHECK: a case-insensitive grep of ALL 29,614 sitemap URLs (categories AND every product URL) for bath|shower|toilet|vanit|sink|basin|faucet|soap|towel|toothbrush|hamper|tub|bidet|lavatory|medicine-cab returns ZERO hits. A grep of the rendered homepage for 'bath' returns ZERO hits. Surya is a wholesale rug / textile / lighting / decor supplier and sells no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures, taps, basins, toilets, bath hardware, bath storage or bathroom furniture of any kind.

DEPARTMENT-BY-DEPARTMENT: Accents = Vases, Decorative Objects, Planters (+ All/New/Top-Sellers/Ready-to-Ship/Clearance). I opened /Catalog/Accents/All (totalItemCount 204) and read its full facet list: the product-type values are Decorative Accent, Vase, Decorative Sculpture, Candleholder/Candle, Decorative Bowl, Bookend, Decorative Tray, Planter, Basket, Bottle/Jar, Box, Umbrella - NO soap dispenser, soap dish, toothbrush holder, tumbler, toilet-roll holder, bath caddy or bath tray. Textiles = Pillows, Poufs, Throws, Bedding, Inserts, Outdoor - no towels, no bath sheets, no bath mats, so nothing to route to Textile. Wall-Decor = Art-and-Accents, Wall-Hangings, Wall-Mirror, Floor-Mirrors. Lighting = Chandeliers-And-Pendants, Floor-Lamps, Table-Lamps, Wall-Sconces - I checked these explicitly per rule 19 and NONE is a bathroom/vanity/IP-rated light node, so nothing was routed to Lighting either. Furniture, Rugs and Outdoor contain no bathroom node.

MIRRORS (rule 10, checked explicitly, not skipped): Surya's only mirror nodes are Wall Decor > Wall Mirror (totalItemCount 539) and Wall Decor > Floor Mirrors (totalItemCount 93). Floor Mirrors' own facets are Full Length Mirror (89), Accent Mirror (9), Leaner Mirror (5) - decorative leaning mirrors, no bathroom type at all. Wall Mirror's facets are Mirror (42) and Vanity Mirror (8); the latter is a query-string filter, not a category, and is logged in review above rather than fabricated into a row.

QTY METHOD (used only for the review entry and the inspection evidence): the 'N Items' header (data-test-selector=productListCountText) that older passes used is no longer rendered anywhere on this site. The authoritative figure is the site's OWN SSR pagination object embedded in the page it renders from: "pagination":{"currentPage":1,"pageSize":24,...,"totalItemCount":N,"numberOfPages":M}. It discriminates cleanly per node (Wall Mirror 539/23 pages, Floor Mirrors 93, Accents All 204, Decorative Objects 45, Vanity-Mirror facet 8), so it is not a site-wide constant, and numberOfPages is always ceil(totalItemCount/24), which is internally consistent.

CONCLUSION: confirmed absence after checking the site's own nav, its complete 123-URL category tree, its complete 29,614-URL sitemap at product level, and every department's facet vocabulary. This is NOT an access failure - all pages were read successfully. Status NO BATHROOM FOUND with rows = [] per rule 36.
